text_sections.label: Effect
text_sections.text:
[Start of Your Main Phase] If your opponent has a Digimon, gain 1 memory.
[Your Turn] When any of your Digimon digivolve into an [ADVENTURE] trait Digimon, by suspending this Tamer, you may play 1 [ADVENTURE] trait card from your hand. For every 2 of your Tamers' colors, reduce this effect's play cost by 1.

text_sections.label: Security Effect
text_sections.text: [Security] Play this card without paying the cost.

qa.answer:
No, you can't.
You can't activate multiple card-playing effects at the same time.
qa.question:
2 copies of this card are in the battle area.
Can I activate the [Your Turn] effect on both copies of this card and play 1 [ADVENTURE] trait card with the play cost reduced by 2?

When I activate this card's [Your Turn] effect and an [ADVENTURE] trait Digimon card would be played, can I activate ST21-13 [Matt Ishida & T.K. Takaishi]'s [Your Turn] effect and reduce the play cost by a total of 2?
